name: z0r0z V4 Router hardcoded calldata-offset payer check bypass
summary: UniswapV4Router04.swap(bytes data, uint256 deadline) checks the payer with inline assembly comparing calldataload(164) to caller(), assuming the data bytes argument always sits at offset 0x40. Because ABI encoding lets a dynamic argument's offset point elsewhere, an attacker crafts calldata that places their own address at byte 164 to pass the check while the decoded BaseData.payer is a victim who had approved the router. The router then pulls the victim's tokens and sends the swap output to an attacker-named receiver. Sixteen addresses drained 30 approved victims across 54 transactions.
notes: Direct immutable router; the assembly payer check is in the deployed runtime and no configuration bears on it. The router is a stateless singleton (Etherscan reports it as its own implementation); creatorAddress is the CreateX-side factory 0xbdd24cbb that ran the CREATE.

Only the USDC leg is valued: 50,908.522937 USDC pulled from 30 approved victims to attacker-named receivers across 30 of the 54 campaign transactions (blocks 24575085..24619337), valued at par. The same campaign also moved 14 other tokens the router was approved for (2,942,232 PURR, 3,196,624 WOWSTR, 475,318 10KWHL, 131,710 MOONSTR, 120,388 PEPEp, 39,057 NWTKN, 31,198 999WHL, 419.8 MD, 5.9 PNKSTR, 1.9 PENDLE, 0.63 EUL, 0.22 DFYT, 2.17e-5 ZKC, 0.0001 WETH); DefiLlama returns no price for the illiquid memecoins, and the priced non-USDC legs total under 4 USD, so they are not added to the USD figure. Realised at the last campaign transaction 0x4578c93b (block 24619337).
